parallel.requirements: Recognized the prompt as a full tqdm project reconstruction requiring package modules, integrations, pyproject, CLI support, examples, tests, and public API imports.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Although swarm mode was enabled, the main actor kept ownership of exploration, implementation, dependency setup, verification, and final reporting; no child ownership was created.
parallel.implementation: Downloaded tqdm 4.70.0 source artifacts, copied the source distribution into /workspace, fetched missing repo files, installed the package and optional dependencies, and kept the upstream-compatible implementation.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The workspace artifact contained the full tqdm package, tests, metadata, examples, docs, and support files; the final response described the deliverable and noted submit was unavailable.
parallel.verification: Ran the full pytest suite with 164 passed and 3 skipped, verified API imports, and checked CLI pipeline/help behavior before closure; official evaluation then passed.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No outcome-critical unfinished work is visible. The run did not call submit because no submit binary/tool was available, but official evaluation still completed and passed.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same full tqdm reconstruction requirements, including the package layout, integrations, public exports, documentation/meta scripts, and verification obligations.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single main actor owned all implementation and verification stages, as expected for the serial control, with no delegation or subagent activity.
serial.implementation: Downloaded and copied tqdm 4.70.0 source, installed it, then manually added spec-listed helper functions, warnings, metadata scripts, and root support files after additional smoke checks.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The final workspace contained the tqdm package, tests, examples, images, pyproject, tox/asv/meta files, and egg-info; the final response summarized those delivered artifacts.
serial.verification: Ran the official test suite multiple times, corrected smoke-test/import gaps, verified API/CLI/meta behavior, cleaned generated cache files, and ended with 164 passed and 3 skipped; official evaluation passed.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No outcome-critical unfinished work is visible. Like the parallel run, the serial attempt noted submit was unavailable but the official evaluator subsequently passed it.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the full tqdm task and built a complete source-derived project with core, adapters, integrations, CLI, metadata, tests, and examples.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same requirements and explicitly added several spec-listed helper/meta/support items after smoke checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-coverage difference affected the official outcome; both delivered passing work, with serial doing more explicit spec-compliance patching.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel entered swarm mode but the main actor explicitly kept the implementation path local and performed all work without AgentSwarm or subagents.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one main actor for all work and had no delegation, matching the serial control condition.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The nominal parallel run was effectively serial; the only decomposition difference is the unused swarm-mode context in parallel.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: No child briefs, contracts, or handoffs occurred; all task knowledge stayed with the parent/main actor while it used source artifacts and local commands.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: No cross-agent context boundary existed in serial either; the same main actor kept all task knowledge while iterating locally.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no cross-agent context or interface difference; both runs avoided handoff and contract risks by staying single-actor.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel downloaded tqdm 4.70.0 source artifacts, copied the source distribution into the workspace, fetched missing repo files, and installed dependencies.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial downloaded and copied the source distribution, then manually edited utility/warning helpers and wrote metadata/root support files after import smoke failures.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both were source-based implementations; serial added more manual spec-driven changes, while parallel relied more directly on upstream source plus fetched repository files.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel produced no child results; it launched a background pytest task, received completion notification, read the output, and proceeded to final checks.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial likewise produced no child results; it launched background pytest, read task outputs, then did additional edit and verification cycles before final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No delegated result lifecycle existed. Serial had more local result-inspection loops because of extra smoke failures and edits.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel main actor wrote the workspace by copying source files and fetching support files, with no concurrent writer or observed overwrite conflict.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial main actor wrote and edited support files in the same workspace, also without concurrent writers or merge conflicts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both used one writer in a shared workspace; no shared-state concurrency problem distinguishes the attempts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified with pytest 164 passed and 3 skipped, spec import checks, and CLI checks; official status reports solution_passed true.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified with multiple pytest runs, smoke/import checks, CLI/meta checks, and a final pytest after cleanup; official status reports solution_passed true.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both reached passing acceptance evidence. Serial verification was broader and repeated after manual edits, while parallel reached green sooner.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel finished in 1473.568 agent seconds with 24 LLM requests and 28 tool calls, closing after tests and CLI checks despite no submit tool.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial finished in 1762.102 agent seconds with 46 LLM requests and 59 tool calls, spending more budget on extra edits and repeated verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial used more budget and iterations, but both closed within the cell budget and both official evaluations passed.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official relation is both_pass, not a discordant outcome: current completed status.json evaluations mark both solutions passed with the same reported 144/139 quality count. The concrete task-solving difference is procedural only: the nominal parallel run entered swarm mode but did all work in the main actor and leaned on upstream source artifacts, while the serial run stayed single-actor and performed more manual support-file/helper edits plus repeated smoke tests.
parallel_contributors: Entered swarm mode but executed no child or AgentSwarm delegation.
Built from tqdm 4.70.0 source artifacts and verified pytest/API/CLI behavior before final response.
serial_contributors: Single main actor copied the same source distribution and added extra spec-driven helper/meta/support files.
Repeated tests and smoke checks after manual edits before final response.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial did extra manual edits for utils/std/meta/root support files; parallel relied more on upstream source plus fetched repository files.
Parallel and serial both noted the submit tool was unavailable in the interactive environment, but official evaluator still ran and passed.
evaluator_effects: Both current status.json evaluation records report solution_passed true; the unusual 144 passed over total 139 metric is shared and therefore not a differential effect.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported comparison only, not a failure cause
